name: Design a fault-tolerant service
short_description: Design a service that survives three specified component failures while preserving data integrity and bounded recovery time.
self_assessment: I can design a service for three component failures without help and verify every recovery objective.
description: Design a service that survives three specified component failures while preserving data integrity and bounded recovery time. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Design recovery for storage, network, and process failures
